slop.quote: This PR defines the pattern again.
The gate exists to block that.
, and the clipboard check was left behind without it
, with a comment explaining the risk and the regression
This restores only the pasteboard pattern. The ASR worker's control-plane scan is not restored, since that worker is retired.
I ran these checks outside this session
and am reporting the results as given.
The reviewer should rerun the planted-call case before merging.
The pattern is a plain text match, so it will also flag any legitimate `declareTypes(` call in shipping code. If there is one, it needs an explicit allowlist entry, not a weaker pattern.
The underlying problem is that an unset variable let the gate pass.
This PR fixes this instance only.

A follow-up should make the script fail closed on any unset variable and should add a CI check that a planted forbidden call makes the gate fail, so a future deletion cannot silently disable a check again.
